title: Associated module functor of equivariant locally constant sections
statement: Let $V$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\ell\in\mathbb N$, $P$ a finite group and $c:Y\to V$ a finite etale $\operatorname{ULift}(P)$-torsor [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Put $k=\mathbb Z/\ell\mathbb Z$ and $\widetilde k=\operatorname{ULift}(k)$. For a $k$-representation $N$ of $P$ and an etale object $W\to V$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], take the submodule of locally constant functions $s:W\times_V Y\to N$ satisfying $s(g y)=\rho_N(g)s(y)$. Restriction is precomposition with the induced map of fibre products, and intertwiners act pointwise. The associated module functor $T_c$ restricts these presheaves along $\widetilde k\to k$ and sheafifies [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], giving sheaves of $\widetilde k$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves].
